entities.name: UE radio capability ID request
entities.description: An information element that the MME may include in WB-S1 mode to request the UE to send its UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: A NAS message that the UE uses to send its UE radio capability ID when requested by the MME.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An identifier representing the UE's radio capabilities that the UE sends in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: A condition where the MME may include the UE radio capability ID request information element.

relations.description: The SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message contains the UE radio capability ID information element when requested.
The inclusion of the UE radio capability ID request IE is guarded by the WB-S1 mode condition.
The UE radio capability ID request triggers the UE to send the UE radio capability ID in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
